hc-undeclared-segment.title: Letter missing from the phonemes
hc-undeclared-segment.meaning: A form uses a letter that isn't a phoneme or boundary marker, so the parser can't read that form.

hc-duplicate-feature-bundle.title: Phonemes with the same features
hc-duplicate-feature-bundle.meaning: Two phonemes have exactly the same features, so rules that choose phonemes by feature can't tell them apart.

hc-stem-no-grammatical-category.title: Stem with no category
hc-stem-no-grammatical-category.meaning: A stem has no category, so affixes that need a category won't attach to it.

hc-inflectional-affix-missing-template-s.title: Inflectional affix in no slot
hc-inflectional-affix-missing-template-s.meaning: An inflectional affix isn't in any template slot, so the parser never adds it to a word.

hc-unclassified-affix.title: Unclassified affix
hc-unclassified-affix.meaning: An affix isn't marked inflectional or derivational, so it can attach anywhere and may build words that aren't real.

hc-partial-reason-unspecified.title: Partly analysed for an unknown reason
hc-partial-reason-unspecified.meaning: An affix is only partly analysed and the parser can't say why; its category and slot are the places to check.

hc-partial-morpheme.title: Partly analysed entry
hc-partial-morpheme.meaning: An entry is missing a category or a slot, so the parser can use it in only some words.

hc-unused-rule.title: Rule never used
hc-unused-rule.meaning: No word can reach this rule, so it never applies.

hc-unused-phoneme.title: Phoneme never used
hc-unused-phoneme.meaning: No form in the lexicon uses this phoneme.

hc-invalid-feature-system.title: Features couldn't be read
hc-invalid-feature-system.meaning: The project's phonological features can't be read, so rules that match by feature may not work.

hc-unresolved-morph-type.title: Morph type couldn't be found
hc-unresolved-morph-type.meaning: An allomorph's morph type can't be found, so the parser can't tell whether it is a stem or an affix.

fwdata.dangling-reference.title: Reference to a missing item
fwdata.dangling-reference.meaning: An item points to something that is no longer in the project, so the parser ignores that link.

fwdata.unexpected-class.title: Item of an unexpected type
fwdata.unexpected-class.meaning: An item is not the kind of thing its field should hold, so the parser skips it.

fwdata.missing-required-field.title: Required field left empty
fwdata.missing-required-field.meaning: An item is missing a field the parser needs, so the parser skips it.

fwdata.missing-lang-project.title: Project data is incomplete
fwdata.missing-lang-project.meaning: The project file holds no language project, so there is no grammar to read.

fwdata.only-first-used.title: Only the first phoneme set is used
fwdata.only-first-used.meaning: The project has more than one phoneme set and, like FieldWorks, the parser reads only the first.

fwdata.empty-representation.title: Phoneme or marker with no spelling
fwdata.empty-representation.meaning: A phoneme or boundary marker has no written form, so the parser can't recognise it in words.

fwdata.unrecognized-enum-value.title: Unrecognised setting
fwdata.unrecognized-enum-value.meaning: An item uses a value this version of the parser doesn't know, so the parser ignores it.

fwdata.metathesis-approximation.title: Metathesis rule read approximately
fwdata.metathesis-approximation.meaning: A metathesis rule could only be read approximately, so it may not swap sounds exactly as written.

fwdata.stale-adhoc-prohibition.title: Ad hoc rule names a missing affix
fwdata.stale-adhoc-prohibition.meaning: An ad hoc rule refers to an affix that is gone, so the rule no longer restricts anything.

fwdata.no-usable-allomorphs.title: Entry with no usable allomorph
fwdata.no-usable-allomorphs.meaning: None of an entry's allomorphs can be read, so words that need that entry can't parse.

fwdata.unsupported-morph-type.title: Morph type the parser can't use
fwdata.unsupported-morph-type.meaning: An allomorph has a morph type the parser doesn't handle, so it skips that allomorph.

fwdata.unknown-morph-type-guid.title: Morph type not in the project
fwdata.unknown-morph-type-guid.meaning: An allomorph's morph type isn't one of the project's morph types, so the parser skips it.

fwdata.reference-not-in-scope.title: Reference from the wrong list
fwdata.reference-not-in-scope.meaning: An item points to something from a list it shouldn't use, so the parser ignores that link.

fwdata.invalid-parser-parameter.title: Invalid parser setting
fwdata.invalid-parser-parameter.meaning: One of the project's parser settings can't be read, so the parser ignores it.

invalid-source.active-parser.title: Unsupported active parser
invalid-source.active-parser.meaning: The project is set to use a parser that PanGloss doesn't support.

invalid-source.duplicate-guid.title: Two items share one identity
invalid-source.duplicate-guid.meaning: Two items in the project have the same identity, so the parser can't tell which one a link means.

invalid-source.missing-guid.title: Item with no identity
invalid-source.missing-guid.meaning: An item has no stable identity, so the parser can't link it back to FieldWorks.

fwdata.writing-system-store-unreadable.title: Writing systems couldn't be read
fwdata.writing-system-store-unreadable.meaning: The project's writing system settings can't be read, so the parser works without them.

snapshot.dangling-reference.title: Link to an item that isn't there
snapshot.dangling-reference.meaning: An item points to something the parser couldn't find, so it ignores that link.

snapshot.feature-structure-unresolved.title: Feature values couldn't be read
snapshot.feature-structure-unresolved.meaning: Some feature values on an item don't match the project's features, so the parser ignores them.

snapshot.rule-feature-unresolved.title: Rule features couldn't be read
snapshot.rule-feature-unresolved.meaning: A phonological rule uses feature values the project doesn't define, so the parser ignores them.

snapshot.reference-out-of-scope.title: Link outside its list
snapshot.reference-out-of-scope.meaning: An item points to something outside the list it belongs to, so the parser ignores that link.

grammar.phoneme.no-representation.title: Phoneme with no grapheme
grammar.phoneme.no-representation.meaning: A phoneme has no written form, so the parser can't find it in words.

grammar.phoneme.nfd-collision.title: Two phonemes spelled the same
grammar.phoneme.nfd-collision.meaning: This phoneme is written the same as an earlier phoneme or marker, so the parser keeps only the first.

grammar.phoneme.feature-unresolved.title: Phoneme features couldn't be read
grammar.phoneme.feature-unresolved.meaning: A phoneme uses feature values the project doesn't define, so rules that match by feature may miss it.

grammar.phoneme.complex-feature-unsuppor.title: Phoneme feature the parser can't use
grammar.phoneme.complex-feature-unsuppor.meaning: A phoneme uses a complex feature value the parser doesn't handle, so it ignores that value.

grammar.boundary.nfd-collision.title: Boundary marker spelled like another
grammar.boundary.nfd-collision.meaning: A boundary marker is written the same as an earlier phoneme or marker, so the parser keeps only the first.

grammar.boundary.no-representation.title: Boundary marker with no spelling
grammar.boundary.no-representation.meaning: A boundary marker has no written form, so the parser can't find it in words.

grammar.boundary.morph-marker-unresolved.title: Morpheme boundary not set
grammar.boundary.morph-marker-unresolved.meaning: The parser settings name a morpheme boundary that isn't a boundary marker, so it isn't used.

grammar.natclass.segments-member-unresol.title: Natural class names a missing phoneme
grammar.natclass.segments-member-unresol.meaning: A natural class lists a phoneme that isn't there, so the class matches less than it should.

grammar.natclass.feature-constraint-unre.title: Natural class features couldn't be read
grammar.natclass.feature-constraint-unre.meaning: A natural class is defined by feature values the project doesn't define, so it may match the wrong phonemes.

grammar.natclass.complex-feature-unsuppo.title: Natural class feature not supported
grammar.natclass.complex-feature-unsuppo.meaning: A natural class uses a complex feature the parser doesn't handle, so it ignores that part of the class.

grammar.feature.phon-complex-unsupported.title: Complex feature not supported
grammar.feature.phon-complex-unsupported.meaning: A complex phonological feature isn't supported, so the parser ignores it.

grammar.stem-name.build-failed.title: Stem name couldn't be loaded
grammar.stem-name.build-failed.meaning: A stem name can't be read, so allomorphs that depend on it aren't restricted by it.

grammar.stem-name.empty-regions.title: Stem name with no regions
grammar.stem-name.empty-regions.meaning: A stem name has no regions, so the parser can't use it to choose between allomorphs.

grammar.compound-rule.build-failed.title: Compound rule couldn't be loaded
grammar.compound-rule.build-failed.meaning: A compound rule can't be read, so words built by it won't parse.

grammar.compound-rule.side-pos-unresolve.title: Compound rule category missing
grammar.compound-rule.side-pos-unresolve.meaning: One side of a compound rule names a category that isn't there, so the rule may join the wrong stems.

grammar.compound-rule.side-exception-fea.title: Compound rule exception missing
grammar.compound-rule.side-exception-fea.meaning: A compound rule's exception feature can't be found, so that exception is ignored.

grammar.msa.build-failed.title: Grammatical info couldn't be loaded
grammar.msa.build-failed.meaning: An entry's grammatical info can't be read, so words that need it may not parse.

grammar.msa.no-allomorphs.title: Grammatical info with no allomorph
grammar.msa.no-allomorphs.meaning: An entry's grammatical info has no allomorph the parser can load, so words needing it can't parse.

grammar.msa.no-rule-form-allomorphs.title: Affix with no usable form
grammar.msa.no-rule-form-allomorphs.meaning: An affix has no allomorph the parser can load, so words that need this affix can't parse.

grammar.msa.exception-feature-unresolved.title: Exception feature missing
grammar.msa.exception-feature-unresolved.meaning: An entry's grammatical info names an exception feature that isn't there, so the parser ignores it.

grammar.msa.inflection-class-unresolved.title: Inflection class missing
grammar.msa.inflection-class-unresolved.meaning: An entry's grammatical info names an inflection class that isn't there, so affixes may attach too freely.

grammar.msa.stem-name-unresolved.title: Stem name missing
grammar.msa.stem-name-unresolved.meaning: An entry's grammatical info names a stem name that isn't there, so the parser ignores it.

grammar.msa.lex-entry-infl-type-unresolv.title: Irregular form type missing
grammar.msa.lex-entry-infl-type-unresolv.meaning: An entry names an irregular inflection type that isn't there, so that form isn't treated as inflected.

grammar.variant.component-unresolved.title: Variant of a missing entry
grammar.variant.component-unresolved.meaning: A variant points to an entry that isn't there, so the parser can't treat it as that entry's variant.

grammar.allomorph.unsegmentable.title: Allomorph with unknown letters
grammar.allomorph.unsegmentable.meaning: An allomorph has letters the grammar doesn't define, so the parser skips it.

grammar.allomorph.morph-type-unsupported.title: Allomorph of an unsupported type
grammar.allomorph.morph-type-unsupported.meaning: This allomorph's morph type isn't one the parser handles here, so it skips the allomorph.

grammar.allomorph.morph-type-unsupported.title: Loaded through its separate parts
grammar.allomorph.morph-type-unsupported.meaning: A circumfix or discontiguous form is loaded as its separate parts, which is expected and needs nothing from you.

grammar.allomorph.not-a-rule-form.title: Affix allomorph with no form
grammar.allomorph.not-a-rule-form.meaning: An affix allomorph has no written form, so the parser skips it.

grammar.allomorph.reduplication-unsuppor.title: Reduplication form not supported
grammar.allomorph.reduplication-unsuppor.meaning: An allomorph uses a reduplication pattern the parser doesn't handle, so it skips the allomorph.

grammar.allomorph.process-build-failed.title: Affix process couldn't be loaded
grammar.allomorph.process-build-failed.meaning: An affix process's input and output can't be read, so the parser skips it.

grammar.allomorph.inflection-class-unres.title: Allomorph inflection class missing
grammar.allomorph.inflection-class-unres.meaning: An allomorph names an inflection class that isn't there, so the parser ignores that restriction.

grammar.allomorph.feature-build-failed.title: Allomorph features couldn't be read
grammar.allomorph.feature-build-failed.meaning: An allomorph's features can't be read, so the parser ignores them.

grammar.allomorph.environment-build-fail.title: Allomorph environment couldn't be read
grammar.allomorph.environment-build-fail.meaning: An allomorph's environment can't be read, so the parser can't use that restriction.

grammar.circumfix.missing-half.title: Circumfix missing a half
grammar.circumfix.missing-half.meaning: A circumfix has only a prefix part or only a suffix part, so the parser can't build it.

grammar.circumfix.environment-combinatio.title: Circumfix environment skipped
grammar.circumfix.environment-combinatio.meaning: An environment on one half of a circumfix can't be combined with the other half, so the parser skips it.

grammar.environment.unresolved.title: Environment missing
grammar.environment.unresolved.meaning: An allomorph refers to an environment that isn't there, so the parser can't apply that restriction.

grammar.environment.invalid.title: Environment couldn't be read
grammar.environment.invalid.meaning: An environment is written in a way the parser can't read, such as naming an undefined natural class, so it is ignored.

grammar.template.slot-unresolved.title: Template slot missing
grammar.template.slot-unresolved.meaning: An affix template refers to a slot that isn't there, so the parser skips that slot.

grammar.template.slot-no-rules.title: Empty template slot
grammar.template.slot-no-rules.meaning: A template slot has no affix the parser can load, so it adds nothing to words.

grammar.template.no-slots.title: Empty affix template
grammar.template.no-slots.meaning: An affix template has no slots with affixes, so it never builds a word.

grammar.template.build-failed.title: Affix template couldn't be loaded
grammar.template.build-failed.meaning: An affix template can't be read, so words that need it won't parse.

grammar.null-affix.mpr-unresolved.title: Null affix restriction missing
grammar.null-affix.mpr-unresolved.meaning: An irregular inflection type names a restriction that isn't there, so the parser ignores it.

grammar.null-affix.syn-fs-failed.title: Null affix features couldn't be read
grammar.null-affix.syn-fs-failed.meaning: An irregular inflection type's features can't be read, so the parser ignores them.

grammar.null-affix.segment-failed.title: Null affix form couldn't be read
grammar.null-affix.segment-failed.meaning: An irregular inflection type's form can't be split into phonemes, so the parser skips it.

grammar.rule.metathesis-unsupported.title: Metathesis rule not supported
grammar.rule.metathesis-unsupported.meaning: A metathesis rule uses features the parser doesn't handle, so it skips the rule.

grammar.rule.build-failed.title: Phonological rule couldn't be loaded
grammar.rule.build-failed.meaning: A phonological rule can't be read, so the parser never applies it.

grammar.rule.feature-constraint-unresolv.title: Rule feature constraint missing
grammar.rule.feature-constraint-unresolv.meaning: A phonological rule's feature constraint can't be found, so the rule may apply too widely.

grammar.rule.feature-constraint-phon-fea.title: Rule constraint names a missing feature
grammar.rule.feature-constraint-phon-fea.meaning: A rule constraint names a phonological feature that isn't there, so the rule may apply too widely.

grammar.rule.rule-feature-unresolved.title: Rule feature missing
grammar.rule.rule-feature-unresolved.meaning: A phonological rule names a feature that isn't there, so the parser ignores that part of the rule.

grammar.strata.custom-unsupported.title: Custom rule levels not supported
grammar.strata.custom-unsupported.meaning: The project's parser settings define their own rule levels, which PanGloss doesn't support.

grammar.adhoc-prohibition.unresolved.title: Ad hoc rule couldn't be read
grammar.adhoc-prohibition.unresolved.meaning: An ad hoc rule refers to forms that aren't there, so it doesn't restrict anything.

grammar.mrule.unreachable-compacted.title: Affix is never used
grammar.mrule.unreachable-compacted.meaning: No word can ever use this affix, so the parser leaves it out.

grammar.cooccurrence.target-unreachable.title: Ad hoc rule is never used
grammar.cooccurrence.target-unreachable.meaning: An ad hoc rule concerns only forms no word can use, so it never applies.

grammar.natclass.unreferenced-compacted.title: Unused natural class
grammar.natclass.unreferenced-compacted.meaning: No rule or environment uses this natural class, so the parser leaves it out.

conversion.source-provenance-unknown.title: Source item not identified
conversion.source-provenance-unknown.meaning: The parser couldn't tell which FieldWorks item this came from, so it can't link back to it.

conversion.unsegmentable-form.title: Allomorph can't be split into phonemes
conversion.unsegmentable-form.meaning: PanGloss can't split this allomorph into the grammar's letters, so it skips this allomorph.

substrate.classification-ambiguous.title: Ambiguous letter in an allomorph
substrate.classification-ambiguous.meaning: A letter in an allomorph could be a phoneme or a boundary marker, so the parser has to guess.

migration.inferred-segment-with-feature-.title: Letter with no phoneme features
migration.inferred-segment-with-feature-.meaning: A letter in the words isn't listed as a phoneme, so it has no features and matches every natural class defined by features.

conversion.unsupported-construct.title: Something the parser can't use
conversion.unsupported-construct.meaning: Part of the project uses a FieldWorks feature PanGloss doesn't support yet, so it skips that part.

substrate.position-unmapped.title: Allomorph letter not matched
substrate.position-unmapped.meaning: A position in an allomorph can't be matched to a phoneme or boundary marker, so the parser may misread it.
